hub.title: PAN Card Photo and Signature Size | SahiSize
hub.description: PAN card photo and signature size from the Protean (NSDL) guideline: photo 3.5×2.5 cm up to 20 KB, signature 2×4.5 cm up to 10 KB. Resize on your phone.
hub.h1: Govt ID Documents: PAN photo and signature size
hub.intro: A PAN application stalls when the photo or signature file is the wrong size. This section lists only the sizes that the issuing agency itself publishes on its website, each with the source link and the date we checked it. The tools below resize your file on your own phone or computer.

paras: We opened the Protean (formerly NSDL e-Gov), UTIITSL and UIDAI websites ourselves. A tool exists only where the agency states pixels, centimetres, KB, DPI or a file format in its own words. Numbers seen only on third-party sites were left out.
You never type a PAN number, an Aadhaar number or your name here. You only pick the photo or signature image, and it does not leave your device.

faq.q: What is the PAN card photo size in KB?
faq.a: Protean’s online PAN guideline lists the photograph as JPEG, 200 DPI, 3.5×2.5 cm and a maximum of 20 KB. Check the official page once before you upload.

faq.q: Do these sizes apply to UTIITSL too?
faq.a: UTIITSL’s public pages only say JPEG/JPG, with no KB or pixel limit. If you apply through UTIITSL, follow the limit its upload screen shows.

faq.q: What is the PAN card photo size in KB?
faq.a: The Protean guideline says a maximum of 20 KB. A Protean help article mentions up to 50 KB, but a file under 20 KB satisfies both, so the tool aims below 20 KB.

faq.q: What is the PAN photo size in pixels?
faq.a: The guideline gives centimetres and DPI, not pixels. At 200 DPI, 2.5 cm wide is about 197 pixels and 3.5 cm tall is about 276 pixels.

faq.q: Does this work as a UTI photo resizer?
faq.a: UTIITSL’s public pages state no KB or pixel limit, only JPEG/JPG. For a UTIITSL form, check the limit its upload screen shows before you rely on this preset.
No. The photo is resized inside your browser, never sent to a server, and gone when you close the page. No PAN or Aadhaar number is asked for either.

paras: Need an NSDL PAN photo resize? Protean (formerly NSDL e-Gov) lists the PAN card photo size for online applications as 3.5×2.5 cm, 200 DPI, colour JPEG, maximum 20 KB. This PAN photo resizer turns your picture into a 197×276 px JPEG (2.5 cm wide, 3.5 cm tall at 200 DPI) under 20 KB.

sections.h2: PAN photo rules in the Protean guideline
paras: Protean’s guidelines for a new PAN and for a PAN change or reprint carry the same scan table. For the photograph it lists resolution 200 DPI, type colour, file type JPEG, size maximum 20 KB and dimension 3.5×2.5 cm.
The table does not say which side is the height. A passport-style photo is upright, so we read it as 3.5 cm tall and 2.5 cm wide.

Most failures have three causes: the file is over 20 KB, it is a PNG or HEIC instead of a JPEG, or the face is too small. The tool fixes the first two by itself; for the third, keep the face large in the crop frame.
list: Use a recent colour photo, with no dark glasses or cap.
Keep the background white or light, with no shadow on the face.
Start from the original photo, not one that was already compressed.

sections.h2: Filling the form at a CSC or cyber café?
paras: The same steps work as a CSC PAN card photo and signature resize tool. Each customer’s photo is made in the browser and never stored, so nothing is left behind when one computer serves many people.

pan-card-signature-size.h1: PAN card signature size: 2×4.5 cm, up to 10 KB
pan-card-signature-size.intro: Choose a photo of your signature below and we will make it ready for the PAN form, right on your phone.

steps.name: Sign on white paper
steps.text: Sign with a black or dark blue pen on plain white paper, a little larger than usual, then photograph or scan it in good light.

steps.name: Pick the image
steps.text: Choose the photo or scan. JPEG, PNG, HEIC and a PDF page all open.

steps.name: Crop tight
steps.text: The frame is locked to 4.5:2. Fit the signature inside the guide with a small margin and no ruled lines.

steps.name: Auto-fit and download
steps.text: The tool cleans the background, makes a 354×157 px JPEG at 200 DPI under 10 KB and checks it. Save pan-signature.jpg when all checks pass.

faq.q: What is the PAN card signature size in KB?
faq.a: The Protean guideline lists a maximum of 10 KB for the signature. The tool keeps a small safety margin below that limit.
At 200 DPI, 4.5 cm wide is about 354 pixels and 2 cm tall is about 157 pixels. The tool also writes 200 DPI into the JPEG file.

faq.q: The guideline says “Color”. Is a black ink signature fine?
faq.a: Yes. “Color” describes the scan type, and the tool saves a normal colour JPEG. A dark ink sign on white paper is what reads best when printed small.

faq.q: Do I need to enter my PAN number?
faq.a: No. The tool only needs the signature image. It never asks for a PAN number, an Aadhaar number or a name, and nothing is uploaded or stored.

paras: For a PAN signature upload, Protean (formerly NSDL e-Gov) lists the scanned signature as 2×4.5 cm, 200 DPI, JPEG, maximum 10 KB. This signature tool crops your sign, whitens the paper and saves a 354×157 px JPEG (4.5 cm wide, 2 cm tall at 200 DPI) under 10 KB.

sections.h2: Signature rules in the Protean guideline
paras: The scan table in Protean’s new PAN and PAN change guidelines gives the signature resolution 200 DPI, type colour, file type JPEG, size maximum 10 KB and dimension 2×4.5 cm.
A signature is wider than it is tall, so we read 2×4.5 cm as 2 cm high and 4.5 cm wide. A 2 cm strip is small, which is why a thick, dark pen line matters more than a neat style.

sections.h2: Why a signature fails at 10 KB
paras: A phone photo of a sign is often several megabytes, with a grey page, shadows and a tilted angle. Squeezing that into 10 KB leaves blotchy noise around faint strokes. Cleaning the paper to pure white first lets the JPEG spend its few bytes on the ink.
list: Turn on cleanup (on by default) and raise the strength if the paper still looks grey.
Rotate in the crop step if the sign is tilted.
If strokes look broken, sign again with a thicker pen rather than raising the size.

sections.h2: Same steps for a PAN correction or reprint
paras: Protean’s change request and reprint guideline uses the identical scan table, so this PAN signature resizer fits a correction form as well as a fresh application.
